title: NFC menu is missing in Android 9
body:
I assume it's an issue of android 9. Under the same version of Xdrip, my old android 6 shows the NFC menu right below "source of data" (the device has no NFC hardware), while my new android 9 does not show it (and to my surprise, it does actually have NFC hardware).

Strange behaviour.

How can I scan with NFC or even start a new sensor?

comments.body:
Please post in support channels.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus
There may be other users who have experienced the same.
